A '''species''' of winged [[Bird/Legends|avians]] were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kilmaulsias]] in the [[Vorzyd Cluster]], where they eventually evolved into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kilmaulsi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Members of the species had [[Color/Legends|colorful]] feathers beneath their jaws and were able to fly using their wings, although the Kilmaulsi lost both the wings and the flying capability but retained the feathers.<ref name="GATORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species were mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a role-playing supplement released by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2004]] for their ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GATORW" />
